Food grade amorphous silica isn't the same as industrial silica. Neither is great to inhale, but the food grade one causes general airway irritation, it does not cause lung cancer like industrial silica.

The food grade silica is safe to ingest, but again it is probably irritating to the throats and airways of the barrisas. Once it is mixed into the beverage, it no longer causes irritation.

Food grade silica is safe for ingestion to the degree that new studies have been published about using it as a stabilizing coating on drugs and medicines that usually have to be kept at very low temperatures for them to remain stable and effective. These drugs can be impossible to ship in hot climates without these coatings.
